mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transaction ( id, transaction_id, customer_id, account_id, transaction_type, amount, currency, counterparty, counterparty_industry, description, transaction_date, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{transactionId}, #{customerId}, #{accountId}, #{transactionType}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{counterparty}, #{counterpartyIndustry}, #{description}, #{transactionDate}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} )

INSERT INTO transaction ( id, transaction_id, customer_id, account_id, transaction_type, amount, currency, counterparty, counterparty_industry, description, transaction_date, created_at ) VALUES
( #{item.id}, #{item.transactionId}, #{item.customerId}, #{item.accountId}, #{item.transactionType}, #{item.amount}, #{item.currency}, #{item.counterparty}, #{item.counterpartyIndustry}, #{item.description}, #{item.transactionDate}, #{item.createdAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, transaction_id, customer_id, account_id, transaction_type, amount, currency, counterparty, counterparty_industry, description, transaction_date, created_at FROM transaction WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, transaction_id, customer_id, account_id, transaction_type, amount, currency, counterparty, counterparty_industry, description, transaction_date, created_at FROM transaction WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY transaction_date DESC

SELECT id, transaction_id, customer_id, account_id, transaction_type, amount, currency, counterparty, counterparty_industry, description, transaction_date, created_at FROM transaction WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY transaction_date DESC
